changeSet.author: dev3
changeSet.comment: Normalisation française (unaccent) et arabe (diacritiques, tatweel, formes de l'alef)
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ged_unaccent(t text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT AS $$ SELECT public.unaccent('public.unaccent'::regdictionary, t) $$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ged_normaliser_arabe(t text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT AS $$ SELECT translate( regexp_replace(t, '[\u064B-\u065F\u0670\u0640]', '', 'g'), chr(1571) || chr(1573) || chr(1570) || chr(1649), repeat(chr(1575), 4)) $$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ged_partie_latine(t text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT AS $$ SELECT regexp_replace(t, '[\u0600-\u06FF\u0750-\u077F\u08A0-\u08FF\uFB50-\uFDFF\uFE70-\uFEFF]+', ' ', 'g') $$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ged_partie_arabe(t text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT AS $$ SELECT regexp_replace(t, '[^\u0600-\u06FF\u0750-\u077F\u08A0-\u08FF\uFB50-\uFDFF\uFE70-\uFEFF\s"-]+', ' ', 'g') $$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ged_document_tsvector(t text) RETURNS tsvector LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT AS $$ SELECT to_tsvector('pg_catalog.french'::regconfig, ged_unaccent(ged_partie_latine(t))) || to_tsvector('pg_catalog.arabic'::regconfig, ged_normaliser_arabe(ged_partie_arabe(t))) $$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ged_requete_texte(q text) RETURNS tsquery LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT AS $$ SELECT websearch_to_tsquery('pg_catalog.french'::regconfig, ged_unaccent(ged_partie_latine(q))) && websearch_to_tsquery('pg_catalog.arabic'::regconfig, ged_normaliser_arabe(ged_partie_arabe(q))) $$
